In mathematics, the '''Tate topology''' is a [[Grothendieck topology]] of the space of [[maximal ideal]]s of a [[Rigid analytic space|''k''-affinoid algebra]], whose [[open set]]s are the [[Admissible set|admissible open subsets]] and whose coverings are the admissible [[open covering]]s.
